reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Claire Cormier Thielke, Managing Director of Asia Pacific for Hines, the largest private real estate investment. Claire responsible for acquisitions, development, and new business generation for Hines APAC and was also recently appointed to the board of Zillow. I was first introduced to Claire two years ago and have wanted to have her on the podcast ever since.

key_points.text: My guest today is Claire Cormier Thielke, Managing Director of Asia Pacific for Hines, the largest private real estate investment.
Her personal story is fascinating - Claire finished Stanford undergrad in 2.5 years and now teaches there - on the intersection of tech and real assets.
